method.resident: strings/lists and amounts are already in each engine; packing/construction is measured separately
method.portable: actual Core/Component APIs, copies, validation, construction, queries, and output conversion
method.stringSharing: both resident engines reuse vocabulary strings; portable calls pay actual string ABI costs
method.controls: raw strings, linear/Map code lookup, scalar Wasm, histogram counts, and typed-array postings
method.queryImplementations: resident walz = composed bitmap path, walzFused = fused query; portable core/component = fused, coreComposed/componentComposed = bitmap path; same inputs/outputs and checksum readers
method.outputChecks: every code/count/returned row is checked outside clocks; per-call checksums consume each result
method.sums: bounded captured integers make JS Number exact; Wasm sums return i64/BigInt
